dialogues.speaker: Warning Board
dialogues.text: (A message board covered in warnings written by tribe members...)

dialogues.speaker: Warning Board
dialogues.text: "So someone hasn't had enough to eat lately, is that it? Who out there's hungry enough to steal from a Tatankasaurus?!"

dialogues.speaker: Warning Board
dialogues.text: "You should know, our saurian has one meeeean temper. If you get caught stealing our Grainfruit, don't come crying to me after you've been trampled into a paste!"
